issue_title: Java News Roundup: JDK 28 Schedule, Oracle CPUs, eMudhra Certs, Apache POI, WildFly, Azul, BellSoft
title: Java News Roundup: JDK 28 Schedule, Oracle CPUs, eMudhra Certs, Apache POI, WildFly, Azul, BellSoft
author: Michael Redlich
description: This week's Java roundup for October 19th, 2026, features news highlighting: the proposed release schedule for JDK 28; the eMudhra Intermediate CA certificates breach; the October 2026 Critical Patch Update; Azul and BellSoft CPUs; GA releases of WildFly 42 and Apache POI 6.0; the beta release of Open Liberty 26.0.0.11; and maintenance releases of Micronaut and JobRunr.

issue_title: TornadoVM 7 Enables GPU-Native Workloads from Java Applications
title: TornadoVM 7 Enables GPU-Native Workloads from Java Applications
author: Ben Evans
description: TornadoVM, an open-source heterogeneous programming framework for Java, has reached version 7.0. It automatically accelerates Java programs on multi-core CPUs and GPUs and provides a rich GPU programming ecosystem in Java that can be used with any mainstream JDK distribution e.g. Temurin, Red Hat OpenJDK, Coretto, Oracle, GraalVM or Zulu. By Ben Evans

issue_title: Java News Roundup: JEPs for JDK 28, Azul Payara, Gatherers4j, Google ADK, Yupiik, Apache Camel CVEs
title: Java News Roundup: JEPs for JDK 28, Azul Payara, Gatherers4j, Google ADK, Yupiik, Apache Camel CVEs
author: Michael Redlich
description: This week's Java roundup for October 12th, 2026, features news highlighting: three OpenJDK JEPs targeted for JDK 28; the October 2026 edition of Azul Payara; point releases of Gatherers4j, Yupiik Fusion, Google ADK for Java and Google ADK for Kotlin; and 38 CVEs resolved in Apache Camel. By Michael Redlich

issue_title: JEP 543 Finalizes Structured Concurrency in JDK 28, Ending Seven Preview Rounds
title: JEP 543 Finalizes Structured Concurrency in JDK 28, Ending Seven Preview Rounds
author: A N M Bazlur Rahman
description: JDK 28 finalizes structured concurrency through JEP 543, with no API changes from JDK 27. Teams on JDK 27 only need to drop --enable-preview and recompile. Code written for JDK 25 or 26 must adapt to the R_X exception type parameter, ExecutionException wrapping, and the abstract timeout() joiner callback. By A N M Bazlur Rahman

issue_title: Helidon 27 Introduces Restructured Programming Models and New Messaging and Data Modules
title: Helidon 27 Introduces Restructured Programming Models and New Messaging and Data Modules
author: Michael Redlich
description: The release of Helidon 27 is the first release that follows the Oracle Tip & Tail Model of Library Development by which the Tip adopts the latest Java technology while the Tail provides a more stable and secure baseline. Concurrent with the release of JDK 27, new features in Helidon 27 include: an introduction to new major modules, Helidon Messaging and Helidon Data JDBC. By Michael Redlich

issue_title: Java News Roundup: Grails 8, Open Liberty, GlassFish, Infinispan, LangChain4j, Spock
title: Java News Roundup: Grails 8, Open Liberty, GlassFish, Infinispan, LangChain4j, Spock
author: Michael Redlich
description: This week's Java roundup for October 5th, 2026, features news highlighting: OpenJDK JEPs Proposed to Target for JDK 28; Lazy Constants elevated to Candidate status; the GA releases of Apache Grails 8.0 and Open Liberty 20.0.0.10; point releases of TornadoVM, Infinispan, LangChain4j and Spock; and a maintenance release of GlassFish. By Michael Redlich

issue_title: Java News Roundup: JobRunr 9, OpenXava 8, Quarkus, LangChain4j, JNoSQL, Introducing Lathe
title: Java News Roundup: JobRunr 9, OpenXava 8, Quarkus, LangChain4j, JNoSQL, Introducing Lathe
author: Michael Redlich
description: This week's Java roundup for September 28th, 2026, features news highlighting: the GA releases of JobRunr 9.0 and OpenXava 8.0; point releases for Quarkus, Micronaut, LangChain4j, Eclipse JNoSQL; ADK for Java and ADK for Kotlin; and introducing Lathe, a new Java language server.

issue_title: Spring News Roundup: Second Milestone Releases of Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Integration
title: Spring News Roundup: Second Milestone Releases of Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Integration
author: Michael Redlich
description: There was a flurry of activity during the week of September 21st, 2026, highlighting: second milestone releases of: Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring Security, Spring AMQP, Spring Integration, Spring Data, Spring Framework, Spring for GraphQL and Spring for Apache Kafka. There were also first milestone releases of Spring AI, Spring Cloud, Spring Web Services and Spring LDAP. By Michael Redlich

issue_title: Java News Roundup: TornadoVM 7.0, Groovy 6.0, GraalVM, Hibernate, Quarkus, Gradle, Maven
title: Java News Roundup: TornadoVM 7.0, Groovy 6.0, GraalVM, Hibernate, Quarkus, Gradle, Maven
author: Michael Redlich
description: This week's Java roundup for September 21st, 2026, features news highlighting: GA releases of TornadoVM 7.0 and Groovy 6.0; point releases of GraalVM and Gradle; maintenance releases of Quarkus and GDK for Micronaut; the seventh release candidate of Maven 4.0; milestone releases of Micrometer Metrics and Tracing; and beta releases of Open Liberty and Hibernate ORM. By Michael Redlich

title: Java News Roundup: JDK 27, Open J Proxy, A2A Jakarta, Azul Payara, BoxLang, Netflix ja
author: Michael Redlich
description: Highlights the GA release of JDK 27, LibericaJDK 27, Open J Proxy 1.0 and A2A Jakarta 1.0; point releases of Azul Payara, JHipster, JetBrains Ktor and BoxLang; and introduces Netflix ja, a modern JMS command-line development experience for Java developers.

title: Java 27 Delivers Post-Quantum Cryptography, Future Language Innovation, Helidon 27, JavaFX 27
author: Michael Redlich
description: Oracle releases version 27 of Java and the JVM. Featuring nine JEPs, this milestone focuses on strengthening post-quantum cryptographic security, future language innovations, and advancements in Helidon 27 and JavaFX 27 under the Java Verified Portfolio.

title: Java News Roundup: New OpenJDK JEPs, CDI 5.0, Spring, Open Liberty, RefactorFirst, ADK for Kotlin
author: Michael Redlich
description: Highlights new JEPs for ahead-of-time compilation and structured concurrency; GA releases of Jakarta CDI 5.0 and ADK for Kotlin 1.0; Open Liberty September 2026 edition; point releases of TornadoVM and RefactorFirst; and release candidates of Groovy 6.0 and Gradle 9.8.

title: Java News Roundup: TornadoVM 6, JReleaser, LangChain4j, Java Operator SDK, JHipster, Yupiik Fusion
author: Michael Redlich
description: Features the GA release of TornadoVM 6.0 for hardware-accelerated Java; point releases of JReleaser, LangChain4j for LLM integrations, the Java Operator SDK for Kubernetes, JHipster, and Yupiik Fusion.

title: Java News Roundup: GraalVM, Jakarta Data, JNoSQL, Azul Payara, WildFly, Quarkus, Atmosphere
author: Michael Redlich
description: Highlights the GA release of Atmosphere 4.0; point releases of GraalVM, Azul Payara, and WildFly; and milestones for Jakarta Data, Eclipse JNoSQL, and Quarkus cloud-native runtimes.

title: FlexGanttFX is Open Source
author: Michael Redlich
description: Dirk Lemmermann releases FlexGanttFX as an open-source resource-scheduling framework under the AGPL license, providing Gantt charts, activity grids, and timeline visualizations for JavaFX desktop client applications.

title: Spring News Roundup: First Milestone Releases for Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Modulith, Batch
author: Michael Redlich
description: After a 10-week hiatus, the Spring team releases first milestone builds for Spring Boot 4.0, Spring Framework 7.0, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Modulith, and Spring Batch, setting the architectural foundation for the next generation of enterprise Java applications.
